concerns.text: Tasks T012b, T013, T016, T019, T020, and T027b implement 'fractal dimension' and 'hierarchical modularity' metrics and regressions. The spec (FR-004, FR-005, FR-007) strictly limits scope to degree, betweenness, and closeness centrality. This constitutes unapproved scope creep and a semantic weakening of the defined requirements by adding unauthorized predictors and outputs not present in the spec.

Task T008c creates configuration for 'fractal dimension estimation' and 'hierarchical modularity'. This is orphan work with no corresponding requirement in spec.md or plan.md, violating the constraint that tasks must not introduce features not authorized by the spec.

Task T016 mandates fitting 'New Models' for fractal metrics against cognitive scores. Spec FR-007 strictly defines the regression scope as 3 centrality metrics × 3 cognitive domains (9 models). Adding new predictors without a spec requirement deviates from the approved statistical analysis plan.

Task T020 requires the PDF report to include a section on 'fractal, hierarchical distribution network findings'. Spec FR-010 defines a fixed set of required figures/tables. Adding unmandated theoretical discussion sections risks violating the report scope and size constraints (SC-004) without spec authorization.

Task T010 mentions 'Resampling to a lower resolution' for CPU efficiency. Spec FR-002 requires specific preprocessing steps (motion correction, slice-time, normalization, band-pass) without mentioning downsampling. While the plan mentions downsampling for CI, the task description implies this as a general method, potentially violating the 'Verified Accuracy' principle if not explicitly authorized as a CI-only equivalent in the task description.
